title: [nightly/library] Keep the app's data on the device between visits (TanStack Query persister)
summary: Adds TanStack Query's persister with idb-keyval so the app keeps its last loaded rounds and stats on the device: pages open with data straight away and still show something offline. Sign-out clears it, and when /auth/me can't be reached the last confirmed golfer is used.
